text:
sam: Quick note from onboarding orion-lite (community). After AWQ int4 (group=128) conversion we see per-head KL increases on code-completion evals; top1 mass jumps on several prompts (avg_top1_fp16=0.18 -> avg_top1_int4=0.41). Suspect rotary projection quantization causing head bias.

rachel: Can you share the convert flags and a tiny repro?

sam: convert command:
```bash
python convert.py --src orion-lite/fp16 --out orion-lite/awq-int4 --quant method=awq,bits=4,group=128 --rotary per_head --export-rot-meta
python eval.py --model orion-lite/awq-int4 --task code_completion --metrics top1,top5_entropy,kl_div
```
Logs: avg_top1_fp16=0.18 avg_top1_int4=0.41 avg_top5_entropy_fp16=0.62 avg_top5_entropy_int4=0.28 kl_mean_per_head: [0.02,0.15,0.01,0.32,...] (heads 3 and 7 worst).

tom: Headwise pattern again. Did you check rot_freq and rot_proj L2 per head? Some exporters output rotated tables with tiny jitter that quant amplifies.

sam: I dumped per-head norms: rotproj_l2_fp16.csv vs rotproj_l2_int4.csv in s3://redwood-ml/tmp/orion-rot/ . Ratios show heads 3 and 7 have int4/fp16 ~0.48 while others ~0.95.

rachel: Try two ablations: 1) run fp16 runtime applying int4-quantized rot tables (isolates rotary effect) 2) run int4 but force global (shared) rotary instead of per-head.

sam: Did those. Results:
- fp16 + int4-rot only -> top1=0.39 (so rotary major factor)
- int4 + global-rot -> top1=0.22 (much closer).

tom: Sounds like a quant grouping artifact on the small rotary tables. Options: a) post-quant per-head spectral calibration (scale each head by fp16_l2 / int4_l2), b) quantize rotary with smaller group or higher precision, c) runtime rescale compensation.

sam: I prototyped (a). After per-head rescale applied pre-pack: avg_top1_int4_cal=0.20 avg_top5_entropy_int4_cal=0.60. Very close to fp16. Pushed toy script to s3 and will open PR for convert util flag --rotary-calibrate.

rachel: Nice. Add a safety check though: if fp16 per-head variance is intentional (some heads deliberately scaled) we should only apply calibration when quantization changes per-head norm variance beyond a threshold (e.g., >15%). Also include an opt-out flag.

tom: Agreed. Also add unit tests in convert to assert that post-calib norms match within tolerance and add a small eval harness to smoke-check ppl on a few prompts.

infra-bot: CI job 4943210002 started: env=ci-small gpu=v100.

sam: Will run a small sweep across community models (zephyr, asterion, orion variants) and post numbers here. If consistent, we should make rotary calibration default for AWQ/GPTQ int4 converters.

rachel: Thanks. Please attach minimal repro snippet in the PR and the csv diffs.

sam: Will do. Thanks all :thumbsup:
